name: Post-flush stabilization entry (1h long the confirmed base)
rationale: MECHANISM (H4 on 1h — a fuller basing confirmation): a slower bar demands the base hold for a full hour before entry, filtering the fake-out bounces that fail on 15m at the cost of a later fill. OI has collapsed and price is basing (range_position lifting, rsi curling up from oversold). Counterparty: late dip-sellers after the forced flow is exhausted. Entry: open_interest below a floor (flush occurred) AND range_position cross_up through a low floor (off the lows) AND rsi cross_up through an oversold-exit level AND vol_realized below a ceiling (post-flush compression). DISCONFIRMER: ablate against H1 on the same sample — no tail/maxDD or net-Sharpe improvement means the confirmation is only lag; range_position cross_up alone matching means generic bottom-fishing. On 1h the entries are fewer but larger — must still beat buy-and-hold net of ~20bps.
catalyst: 1h confirmed base after an OI flush: price off lows, RSI curling, vol compressing
